root_cause_analysis: Instagram Graph API request failed with error code 4 and subcode 2207051 ('Action is blocked'). The account or application has triggered Meta's rate limits or automated security restrictions, blocking further publishing activities.
actionable_instructions: Log into the Meta Business Manager / Developer Dashboard to inspect active account restrictions or policy warnings.
Pause automated Instagram publishing workflows for 24 hours to allow the action block to expire.
Verify that publishing frequency adheres to Instagram Graph API rate limiting guidelines.
